run_train_flow_matching: run the flow matching training loop for a Transformer model on text data with distributed data parallel
setup_distributed_training: setup PyTorch distributed process group with NCCL backend for multi-GPU training on localhost
run_mp_training_entry: run multi-process training by setting up distributed processes, training the model, and cleaning up
cleanup_distributed_group: cleanup and destroy the PyTorch distributed process group after training completes
review_run_train: review the run_train function to understand the training loop with checkpointing, evaluation, and text generation
